title: Polish src/bencode/decode.zig: dead -0 check, pos-on-error doc, length leading-zero doc, allocator doc
description: From M0.T7 review (commit 85963da): (1) Remove dead 'if (eql(digits,"-0"))' check at line 47 — subsumed by the next line's leading-zero-after-minus check. (2) Document at top of Parser that pos is undefined after any error return (parseInt advances past 'e' before validating; parseString does not). (3) Document that parseString accepts leading zeros on the length prefix (BEP 3 doesn't forbid it; most decoders accept). (4) Comment that the allocator field is unused in scalar parsing but consumed by T8 list/dict allocation. Best absorbed while T8 is editing this file.
acceptance_criteria: dead check removed; three doc comments added

title: Polish src/log/ring.zig: guard zero capacity; document deinit lifetime; remove vestigial dropped counter

Add std.debug.assert(capacity > 0) or doc precondition. (2) Important — add /// note on deinit: caller must ensure no thread is in pop() when called. (3) Cleanup — concurrent-drain test threads a 'dropped' counter that's never incremented; the 'if maxInt break' is dead code. Either remove the parameter or wire dropped to count real drops.
acceptance_criteria: zero-cap guarded; deinit doc'd; dropped logic cleaned
